_comment: Stage 3: blue MOT capture + blue->red handoff (coil boost, blue capture attenuation ramp, transfer time, blue power). Run AFTER stages 1-2 with their winners set as GUI defaults. NOTE bmot_load_duration is NOT optimized — it is held fixed at the experiment's bmot_load_duration_fixed (default 0.5 s). Bounds are FILLERS — tighten to safe ranges. IMPORTANT: max(bmot_current)+max(binc) is kept <= MAX_CURRENT (7 A) so no candidate trips the coil assertion; keep it that way if you widen these. (Any infeasible candidate is auto-marked 'bad', not fatal.)
_units: bmot_current/binc in A (bmot_current+binc < 7), bmot_ramp_duration and blue_transfer_time in seconds, blue_att_i/blue_att_f and atten_3D in dB (1-30)
